headline: Literary prizes are for writers, not machines
claim: AI models were trained on more than 191,000 pirated books, with authors neither consenting nor being paid.
notes: published 2026-11-05 (culture newsletter). Secondhand: the 191,000 figure is attributed to an Atlantic investigation; the Atlantic piece was not checked and its date is unclear. Newsletter also says Anthropic settled with authors for $1.5bn; not verified here. Allegations and reporting, not findings.
